in_arabic.name: ابراهيم
in_arabic.meaning: أبو الرحمة، أب الرحيم، الأب العظيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ابراهيم مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'أ ب ر ح م' والذي يعني الأب الرحيم أو الأب العظيم، ويعتبر إبراهيم عليه السلام أحد الأنبياء المهمين في الإسلام، حيث كان أبو النبي إسماعيل وإسحق، ويحظى باحترام كبير في التقاليد الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: ابراہیم
in_urdu.meaning: رحمت کا ابو، بڑا رحمدل اب
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابراہیم نام کی اصطلاح عربی جڑ 'أ ب ر ح م' سے نکالی گئی ہے، جس کا مطلب رحمت کا ابو یا بڑا رحمدل اب ہے، ابراہیم علیہ السلام اسلام میں ایک اہم نبی مانے جاتے ہیں، جنہوں نے نبی اسماعیل اور اسحق کے نانا ہونے کی حیثیت سے اہمیت حاصل کی

in_hindi.name: अब्राहिम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अब्राहिम नाम अربي मूल 'أ ب ر ح م' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दयालु पिता या महान दयालु, इस्लाम में अब्राहिम एक महत्वपूर्ण नबी माने जाते हैं, जिनकी वंशावली में नबी इस्माइल और इसहाक हुए

in_pashto.name: ابراهيم
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ابراهيم نوم د عربي ريښو 'أ ب ر ح م' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د رحمې پلار يا لورنی رحمدار معنی لري، ابراهيم په اسلام کې يو مهم نبی دی، چا چې د نبي اسماعيل او اسحاق د نيکه په توګه تاريخي اهميت لري

in_english.name: Abram
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abram originates from the Arabic root 'أ ب ر ح م', signifying 'exalted father' or 'high-born father', in Islamic tradition, Abram or Ibrahim is a significant prophet and forefather of several prophets, embodying compassion and monotheism

pronunciation.urdu: ابراہیم کا تلفظ ہے 'ا ب ر ا ہ ی م'
pronunciation.hindi: अब्राहिम का उच्चारण है 'अ ब रा हि म'
pronunciation.pashto: د ابراهيم تلفظ دے 'ا ب ر ا ه ي م'

data.cultural_impact: Abraham, also known as Ibrahim in the Arabic language, is considered one of the most important figures in Islamic history. He is often referred to as the 'father of the prophets' because of his unwavering faith and obedience to God. The story of Abraham is recounted in the Quran and his acts of devotion, such as the willingness to sacrifice his son Ishmael, continue to inspire and influence the Muslim Ummah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Abram holds great spiritual significance for Muslims as it reminds us of the unwavering faith and obedience of one of the greatest Prophets in Islamic history. The name encourages us to emulate the character traits of Abraham, such as submission to God, unwavering faith, and total obedience. This spiritual connection to the name Abram is a valuable reminder of the importance of faith and devotion in our daily lives.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibrahim (Arabic for Abraham) is mentioned frequently in the Quran and is considered a prophet in Islam.
The name Ibrahim (Abraham) appears in the Islamic Hadith literature, which records the sayings, actions, and Approval of the Prophet Muhammad.

It is widely recognized as a symbol of monotheism and is celebrated for his unwavering faith in God. Abram is featured prominently in Islamic art, literature, and education. On Instagram, users often post images and quotes from the Quran or Hadiths related to Abram, using the hashtag #Abram or #Abraham. On Facebook, there are numerous groups dedicated to discussing and learning about the life and teachings of Abram. Pinterest is another platform where users can find and share images of Islamic art and calligraphy that feature the name Abram. Overall, the name Abram continues to be a source of inspiration and education for those interested in Islamic history and spirituality.
